meta.name: Birthday Game V2 Asset Requirements
meta.principle: Semantic keys only. Generate or map files later. No UI component may hardcode image paths.
notes: This is a requirements manifest, not a file-path manifest.
Backgrounds and header icons are mandatory for every level.
Decorative art must never be placed inside interaction zones unless it is explicitly interactive.
Any clickable object must have an interactive state or clear affordance.
Level 18 needs no new illustration for answers beyond reusable Player 1 / Player 2 cards.
Final asset production should preserve one coherent pixel-art style across all levels.
v2.0.1 fixes: bg_warm_room is explicitly mapped to Levels 2 and 3; badge_factchecker and item_chess_piece are now declared.
v2.1 adds the post-Level-30 bonus mission and legacy Boeing 737 simulator certificate flow.
